result.topic_en: A short note stating that, under the assumption that the virtual moment of all forces is a complete differential, one obtains the general law of motion (conservation of energy: kinetic energy minus a potential is constant).
result.transcription:
Unter der Voraussetzung, daß das virtuelle Moment sämmtlicher
Kräfte ein vollständiges Differential {+dP+} [?] haben wir folgendes
allgemeine Bewegungsgesetz gefunden:
$\frac{1}{2}\sum\left(m\left(\left(d\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2+\left(d\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2+\left(d\frac{dz}{dt}\right)^2\right)\right) - P_{t+dt} = \text{Const.}$

methods.what: Energy conservation law (kinetic energy minus potential is constant) derived under the assumption that the virtual work of the forces is an exact differential
